scope: Elementary identities and a reproduction of published code formulas; no cosmological inference.

de_sitter.note: All three entropy expressions are the same quantity; Bousso N-bound uses Lambda>0 and is trivial as Lambda->0.

closed_de_sitter.meaning: Compact S^3 slices, positive vacuum density, p=-rho: all GR constraints hold for any H>0. Closure fixes neither rho_Lambda nor p=0.

power_law_fading.meaning: Fading density with w>-1 can keep an event horizon; no Minkowski future follows.

gauss_law.meaning: Total gauge charge on a compact boundaryless space vanishes; a lone net charge has no Gauss-law solution (the k=0 Fourier mode of rho must vanish). Global (ungauged) charges are not constrained by this.

finite_clock.meaning: A constraint alone does not force a one-dimensional physical space; the one-state claim comes from the nonperturbative path integral / factorization, not from H=0.

huz_code.meaning: Effective inner products are reliable only to ~e^{-S_Ob}, and the effective space has dimension <= e^{S_Ob} (dimension of the clone space). An e^{10^122}-state effective description in this dictionary needs an observer with S_Ob >~ 10^122 nats, i.e. of order the de Sitter entropy itself.

huz_code_large_d.meaning: Effective inner products are reliable only to ~e^{-S_Ob}, and the effective space has dimension <= e^{S_Ob} (dimension of the clone space). An e^{10^122}-state effective description in this dictionary needs an observer with S_Ob >~ 10^122 nats, i.e. of order the de Sitter entropy itself.

huz_exact_formula: Var = (d/(d+2)) (1+|<phi*|psi>|^2)/d_obs - 2|<phi|psi>|^2/(d+2); -> HUZ eq. (4.2) leading term (1+|<phi*|psi>|^2)/d_obs when d >> d_obs [D]
